Pgbert as clerk or typewriter at Naval Academy, Annapolis, Md.]. Oct. 5, 1926. 1p. f° (No. 4520.) <. Pr 30.5: Eg 18 ‘glascock, Mrs. Barbara. Executive order [authorizing employment of Mrs. Barbara Glascock as stenographer and typewriter in 11th naval district, San Diego, Calif.]. Oct. 11, 1926. 1p. f° (No. 4521.) ¢ Pr 30.5: G 461 Government officials and employees. Executive order [amending Executive order of June 19, 1924, by directing that employees be permitted to remain in positions they were occupying on July 1, 1924, and may receive salary increases up to maximum of grade to which such positions have been allo- eated, but shall not thereby be given any status for promotion, transfer, or reinstatement different from that which they have regularly acquired under civil service law and rules, except that Civil Service Commission may, without examination, permit reinstatement or promotion in same Depart- ment or establishment back to same class of positions as that occupied on July 1, 1924, after separation or demotion without fault or delinquency]. Oct. 18, 1926. 1p. f° (No. 4523.) ¢ Pr 30.5: C 499/32 Military reservations. Executive order [transferring portion of Fort Pike military reservation, La., to Commerce Department for use as lighthouse reservation]. Sept. 15, 1926. 1p. map, f° (No. 4510.) ¢ Pr 30.5: L 626/3 — Executive order [transferring portion of St. Joseph’s Bay military reser- yation, Fla., to Commerce Department for use as lighthouse reservation}. Oct. 21, 1926. 1p. f° (No. 4525.) £ Pr 30.5 : L 626/4 Vinnesota. Executive order, Minnesota [temporarily withdrawing land in Minnesota from settlement, etc., for classification and pending determina- tion as to advisability of including same in Superior National Forest]. [Oct. 14, 1926.] [2] p. f° ([No. 4522.]) ¢ Pr 30.5: M 666/4 Oregon. Executive order, Oregon [revoking Executive order of May 8, 1925, which temporarily withdrew certain public lands in Oregon, as to such por- tions of certain areas as have not been included within Whitman National Forest, and authorizing that said lands be opened to entry only under homestead or desert land laws by qualified ex-service men of War with Germany for period of 91 days, after which any remaining land may be open to general public under any public land law applicable thereto]. Oct. 18, 1926. 1p. f° (No. 4524.) = Pr 30.5: Or 3/14 {| — JExecutive order, Oregon [temporarily withdrawing certain public lands in Oregon from settlement, ete., for classification and in aid of legislation]. Sept. 23, 1926. 1p. f° (No. 4515.) + Pr 30.5: Or 3/13 Point-brush handles. Decreasing rate of duty on paint brush handles, procla- mation [authorizing certain decrease in duty on paint brush handles, in order to equalize differences in costs of production in United States and Canada]. {Oct. 14, 1926.] 2 p. f° ([No. 1785.]) 7 Pr 30.7 : H 192 ; ( Upper Mississippi River Wild Life and Fish Refuge. Executive order, Upper Mississippi River Wild Life and Fish Refuge, 2d Executive order. [Oct. 2, 1926.] [2] p. map, f° ({No. 4519.]) ¢ Pr 30.5: Up 6/2 SHIPPING BOARD Commerce. Comparative summary of water borne foreign commerce, with } graphic charts, Jan. 1, 1921—Apr. 30, 1926; [prepared in] Bureau of Research, Division of Statistics. July 27, 1926. 1 p. 3 pl. oblong large 8° (Report D. 8. 399.) [Bi-monthly.] + SB 7.5/390 : 926/1 SHIPPING BOARD EMERGENCY FLEET CORPORATION | Ships.
